stage1_plan.missing_check: admin authentication gate using PHPOLL's cookie/config-credential check; modifica_votanti.php never initializes or checks $test_log before the vote deletion/update queries.
stage1_plan.insertion_location: In admin/modifica_votanti.php, after `mysql_select_db($phpoll_database, $phpoll_db) or die (...)` and before the sensitive `$query_voti`/delete/update block (before `// QUERY per MySQL` and `$query_voti =`).
stage1_plan.reused_project_semantics: Uses PHPOLL's real admin auth pattern from admin/band_editor.php, admin/config_editor.php, and admin/votanti.php: config-table credentials from phpoll_<prepoll>_configurazione, cookie names phpoll_<prepoll>_login and phpoll_<prepoll>_password, values $dati_login['login'] and $dati_login['password'], sentinel $test_log=false/true, and the project's JS window.location redirect style used at the end of admin/modifica_votanti.php.
stage1_plan.reason: A visitor has no valid admin cookies, so $test_log remains false. The guard redirects to index.php and exits before any SELECT/DELETE/UPDATE on votes, preserving intended admin access for users whose phpoll_<prepoll>_login/password cookies match the configuration credentials.

stage2_messages.content: Generate a minimal source-code access-control patch. Reuse project guard semantics exactly. Unauthorized requests must be blocked before sensitive operations. Do not refactor unrelated code. Return only JSON, no Markdown.

stage2_patch.explanation: Inserted the project's existing PHPOLL admin authentication guard after the database selection and before any vote SELECT/DELETE/UPDATE operations. The guard reads the configured admin credentials from phpoll_<prepoll>_configurazione, checks the phpoll_<prepoll>_login and phpoll_<prepoll>_password cookies using the same $test_log sentinel pattern used by admin/band_editor.php, admin/config_editor.php, and admin/votanti.php, and denies unauthenticated users by redirecting to index.php and exiting. Authorized admins with matching cookies continue to the original modification logic unchanged.
